title: fix(components): declared action renderers forward objectName and honour onClick (objectui#4202)
body:
Fixes #4202
Clause-②: no

The four declared action renderers (`action:button`, `action:icon`, `action:group`, `action:menu`) now forward `objectName` to the runner. `action:button`, `action:icon` and `action:group` now also honour `onClick` the way `action:menu` already did. The seven `KNOWN_GAPS` rows `check:action-forward-parity` held for this card are deleted, and the gate is green without them.

Claim `5822389099` (seat `domain:ui#1`). Implementing session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`.

## What changed

- **`objectName`, all four renderers.** Each builds the runner's input from an explicit key allowlist. `objectName` is now appended at the tail of each allowlist (after `onSuccess`, the objectui#5493 position), so no existing key moves. The console resolves the target object as `action.objectName || page object` in its api and flow handlers, in the param dialog's i18n scope, and in `createServerActionHandler`'s `/api/v1/actions/{object}/{action}` URL. Before this change, an action declaring a different object was dispatched against the page's object. An action that declares none still falls back to the page object.
- **`onClick`, three renderers.** `action:button` / `action:icon` (in `handleClick`) and `action:group` (in its one `handleExecute`, shared by both display modes) now open with the same branch `action:menu` and `page:header` use: if `onClick` is a function, call it and return before the runner.
- **`scripts/check-action-forward-parity.mjs`.** Both `KNOWN_GAPS` blocks for this card are deleted, so the table is now empty. `onClick` is recorded as consumed at the renderer on all four surfaces: one `JUSTIFIED` row per surface replaces the single `action:menu:onClick` row, and its stale `action-menu.tsx` line address becomes a content citation. Two comments that this change made false are reworded; neither states the table's population any more.
- **`action-forward-precedence.test.tsx`.** Its two key-order lists gain the appended `objectName`, the same way `onSuccess` was added.
- **Changeset.** `minor` on `@object-ui/components`. User-visible effect: an action that declares `objectName` now acts on that object.

## `onClick`: invoked, not forwarded

The runner reads `onClick` only as a late fallback. It runs only after no registered handler and no builtin executor exists for the declared type (`ActionRunner.execute`'s `else if (action.onClick)` leg). `UIActionSchema.onClick` is documented to take precedence over `type` / `target`, so forwarding it would not honour that. A button with the default `actionType: 'script'` would still run the script. Calling it in the renderer is the semantics `action:menu` and `page:header` already have.

## Premise check (all on `origin/main` `62bc8a250`)

- All four allowlists lacked `objectName`. Only `action:menu` invoked `onClick`, in the `UI-local escape hatch` branch of its `handleExecute`.
- `KNOWN_GAPS` held 7 rows citing this card, as two `Object.fromEntries` blocks. Gate baseline: exit 0, 19 justified omissions and 7 known gaps.
- Every runtime reader of `action.objectName` takes it first and falls back otherwise (`||`, `??`, or `!action.objectName || action.objectName === objectName`). So an action whose `objectName` names the page's own object behaves exactly as before. The readers are `useConsoleActionRuntime`, `RecordDetailView`, `recordFormNavigation`, `ActionRunner`'s update-undo and `createServerActionHandler`.

## Tests and gates (all at `bea0e5eb5`, the final commit)

- New `action-objectName-onClick-4202.test.tsx`, 12 rows, one per surface per claim. Pin (a): a `crm_contact` action on a `crm_account` page POSTs to `/api/v1/actions/crm_contact/send_welcome`, and the forwarded def carries the key. Pin (b), the control: with no `objectName`, it POSTs to `crm_account`. The consumer is the real `createServerActionHandler`, registered the way the console registers it: `resolveObject` answers the page object and only the transport is stubbed. Pin (c): `onClick` runs exactly once, while the `script` handler and `onConfirm` are never called. `action:menu` is included as the reference row.
- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/components^...' build` built the dependency closure (8 of 47 projects), exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. `--listFiles` includes the new test (1 hit; the control `action-onSuccess-forward.test.tsx` also gets 1).
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/src/renderers/ packages/components/src/ui/ packages/components/src/notifications/`: 124 files, 1174 passed, 10 skipped.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/`: 171 files (170 passed, 1 skipped), 1668 passed, 7 skipped. Together with the run above, this is every test file in the package.
- 25 test files in other packages that render these renderers with `onClick` / `objectName`, or read their source as text (derived by `git grep`, per the dispatch's lesson). Across app-shell, react, core, types, plugin-detail and schema-catalog: 25 passed, 1186 tests.
- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/`: 181 files (179 passed, 2 skipped), 5306 passed. This includes the gate's own suite and its closing-keyword suite.
- Exit 0 on each of: `check:action-forward-parity` (22 justified, 0 known gaps; forwards 25 / 22 / 22 / 22), `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check-changeset-presence`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check-changeset-fixed` / `-no-major` / `-overwrite`, `check-type-check-coverage`, `check-test-path-roots`, the three `check-vi-mock-*`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:unreferenced-sources`. `check-governed-queue-guard --test`: NOT GOVERNED.
- `check:changeset-claims` (report-only) asked me to re-read two pending paragraphs: `6306-action-icon-type-resolution.md` and `action-onsuccess-forward-5493.md`. Each describes its own change and is still true.
- eslint over the 7 touched code and test files: 0 errors and 50 warnings. 4 of the warnings are new, all `no-explicit-any` on the `objectName` casts (see Acceptance notes). There is no warnings cap.

## One-off proofs (committed state, `objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` wrap mode, each restore proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`)

1. **`objectName` removed from `action:icon`'s allowlist** (anchor 1 then 0, blob `d6235f98` then `e52e41d4`). The pin went red on exactly one row, `action:icon — a declared objectName is where the action lands`, with "dropped objectName one hop before the runner: expected undefined to be 'crm_contact'". The other 11 rows stayed green, including that surface's control. The gate went red with exit 1: "action:icon ... does not forward 1 key the runtime reads: `objectName`". The file was restored to `d6235f98`.
2. **`onClick` branch disabled in `action:group`.** The pin went red on exactly one row, `action:group — calls onClick and never reaches the runner` (the callback was called 0 times). The gate stayed at exit 0, as predicted: it reads forwards, so consumption at the renderer is a `JUSTIFIED` claim the gate cannot check. The runtime pin is what guards it. The file was restored to `a0cfeb41`.
3. **Stale-waiver rule.** Re-seeding `KNOWN_GAPS` with `action:button:objectName` made the gate exit 1 with "KNOWN_GAPS entry `action:button:objectName` is no longer a gap — delete it". The file was restored to `a3eb53e1`.

## Acceptance notes

- **The `objectName` reads are cast `as any`.** The `@object-ui/types` mirror `UIActionSchema` does not declare `objectName`, although spec `ActionSchema` does and `ActionDef` does: a bare read fails `tsc` with TS2339. The write side is checked against `ActionDef`. Aligning the mirror (the objectui#8648 route) would let all four reads drop the cast, but it is outside this claim's file surface and would widen a published type. Owner: none.
- **Test-file prose this change made stale, outside the claim's file surface.** No assertion changes. `scripts/__tests__/check-action-forward-parity-closing-keyword.test.ts` has a failure message saying "KNOWN_GAPS is not empty in this tree". That test seeds its own ledger and stays green, and the message is still reachable one entry away. The docblock of `packages/types/src/__tests__/handler-keys-string-any-mirrors-7344.test.ts` lists the `onClick` readers as `action-menu.tsx`, `containers.tsx` and `record-quick-actions.tsx`; the three renderers here now read it too. Owner: none.
- **Scope declaration.** The claim's file surface names "the forward allowlist only" and "the two `KNOWN_GAPS` lines". The `onClick` branch sits beside each allowlist, as scope item 1 requires. In the gate file, the `JUSTIFIED` rows and the two reworded comments follow directly from the same change. No file outside the declared surface is touched.
- **`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`: NOT MEASURED.** It is the board patrol, not a diff gate, and it answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3) for lack of a GitHub credential in this container.
